def main():
    x = input().strip()
    if not x:
        print()
        return
    y = [x[0]]
    i = 1
    stop = False
    while i < len(x):
        # Check for "at" (first occurrence only)
        if (i + 1 < len(x) and x[i] == 'a' and x[i + 1] == 't' and
                len(x) - i > 2 and not stop):
            y.append('@')
            i += 2
            stop = True
        # Check for "dot"
        elif (i + 2 < len(x) and x[i] == 'd' and x[i + 1] == 'o' and x[i + 2] == 't' and
              len(x) - i > 3):
            y.append('.')
            i += 3
        else:
            y.append(x[i])
            i += 1
    print(''.join(y))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
